description: AgentBoard status feed. Generated from agentboard/team.json by agentboard/generate.mjs. Edit team.json, then re-run it.

hooks.command: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/agentboard/report.mjs" ]; do p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$p; done; node "$d/agentboard/report.mjs" --hook codex SessionStart; exit 0' >/dev/null 2>&1; true
